text_block_list.text: One day, upon visiting the gym――

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: One, two! One, two!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oooone... *haa*...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Twooo... *haaa*~...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ... Kawakami-san.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes!?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You are sighing far too much. It is 
utterly impossible for me to concentrate.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I'm... I'm so sorry! I was being a 
nuisance, wasn't I――

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
So, tell me why you keep sighing. It will 
be marginally better than keeping it all 
to yourself, won't it?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...The first-rate horse girl you admire 
shall demonstrate that she is also 
first-rate at offering counsel.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...! King-san...!! The truth is, the truth 
is~~...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Lately my shoulders have become so brawny 
that I don't look princess-like at all~~!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
If I become a swole muscle horse girl 
instead of a delicate maiden, my prince 
will never come to sweep me off my feet~~!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...*Sigh*. You may act shy on occasion, 
but you can also be exceptionally foolish 
at times.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
What is considered "princess-like" varies 
from person to person.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Why are you training your shoulder muscles 
in the first place? Why do you want to 
become faster?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...To become faster than anyone else, so 
my prince can find me.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Exactly. Then those muscles are proof of 
the effort you put in to get closer to 
your goal. Rejecting that is utter 
foolishness.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You didn't want to just be a 'princess who 
merely waits,' which is why you came to 
this academy, isn't that right?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
――King-san. You are right... You are so 
right...!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna hoist this 150kg barbell 
sky-high~~!! *Hnnnnngh*~~!! 
*Hnnnnnnnngh*~~!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: My, quite high-spirited, aren't we?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...I cannot afford to lose either.
